_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve surface_pde#4: on an evolving (growing) sphere, ALE via mesh.SetDeformation keeps the coefficient vector and transports the field exactly, while re-meshing per step loses it. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, OCC sphere maxh=0.4 Curve(3), H1 order 2 on Boundaries('.*'), c=x*y+z (2026-08-06): under SetDeformation with s=0.05/0.10/0.20 both the area and Integrate(c*c*ds) scale by exactly (1+s)^2 to 1.1e-04 relative, and UnsetDeformation restores. Re-meshing takes ndof 381 -> 426/463/509, so a raw vector copy raises NgException 'BaseVector::Set: size of me = 426 != size of other = 381' and gf_new.Set(gf_old) returns without raising having produced the exactly-zero field. Correction to the claim: the loss is not ~1-3% per step, it is total and silent.
